title: Velvety Mustardy Brazilian Burger
description: Inspired by the monsoon season in Brazil, this burger features a velvety mustard sauce and sesame seed buns. The unique flavor profile makes it a perfect meal for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Pound 500g of ground beef in a mortar and pestle until it is finely ground.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and continue pounding until the meat is almost smooth.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties and cook for 5 minutes on each side, until browned.
While the patties are cooking, toast the sesame seed buns by placing them in the pan for 1 minute on each side.
